resources.string: GuardTalk Messenger. Register a RING account on the Gateway LAN and send text. Public Jami is not used.
Connect to the GuardTalk Gateway Wi-Fi, tap Register, then send to a 40-character Jami peer ID. Off the LAN, messaging stays off.
Looking up the Gateway on this Wi-Fi…
No Gateway on this Wi-Fi. Join the GuardTalk Gateway SSID. Messaging is off until then.
Gateway address is not a private LAN (RFC1918). Messaging is blocked. Public Jami is not used.
Gateway %1$s is ready. Register a RING account to send.
Text sent only through Gateway jamid
No conversations. Connect to the Gateway Wi-Fi first.
No conversations. Register a RING account, then refresh.
No conversations yet. Send a text or refresh after the peer accepts.
Gateway %1$s is not answering on port 8080. Stay on the LAN. jamid may be down.
Gateway %1$s timed out. Stay on the LAN and retry.
Gateway HTTP error (%1$s). jamid may be down.
Enter the 40-character Jami peer ID before sending.
Peer ID must be 40 hexadecimal characters.
